newsitem.title: USA: Republic buys 2 firms for $36 mln in stock.
newsitem.headline: Republic buys 2 firms for $36 mln in stock.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc said it has acquired Acadiana Alarm Systems of Lafayette, La., and Commonwealth Security Systems of Lancaster, Pa., for $36 million in Republic stock plus assumption of debt.
Both companies are in the business of selling, installing and monitoring electronic commercial and residential security systems, Republic said. The two firms serve about 40,000 accounts in 11 states.
It said it expects the transaction will be accounted for as a pooling of interests.
